aj_person.name: aj_person
aj_person.value: kind <> 'stage1' or person_id is not null

ca_time_precision.name: ca_time_precision
ca_time_precision.value: time_precision is null or time_precision in ('date', 'minute', 'unknown')

ca_event_time_source.name: ca_event_time_source
ca_event_time_source.value: event_time_source is null or event_time_source in ('answer_value', 'document_sampled_on', 'session_started_at', 'none')

ca_value.name: ca_value
ca_value.value: (skipped and value is null and upload_id is null) or not skipped

cs_scope_document.name: cs_scope_document

dmm_doc_type.name: dmm_doc_type
dmm_doc_type.value: doc_type is null or doc_type in ('lab_report', 'imaging_report', 'prescription', 'discharge_summary', 'pathology', 'outpatient_note', 'checkup_report', 'ecg', 'vaccination', 'infusion_order', 'other', 'unknown')

enc_grouping_basis.name: enc_grouping_basis
enc_grouping_basis.value: grouping_basis is null or grouping_basis in ('event_time', 'capture_date_degraded')

obs_time_consistency.name: obs_time_consistency

obs_comparator.name: obs_comparator
obs_comparator.value: comparator is null or comparator in ('<', '<=', '=', '>=', '>')

obs_abnormal_flag.name: obs_abnormal_flag
obs_abnormal_flag.value: abnormal_flag is null or abnormal_flag in ('low', 'high', 'critical_low', 'critical_high', 'abnormal', 'normal', 'unknown')

obs_value_present.name: obs_value_present
obs_value_present.value: value_num is not null or value_text is not null or value_dimensions is not null

obs_comparator_numeric.name: obs_comparator_numeric
obs_comparator_numeric.value: comparator is null or value_num is not null

obs_concept_series.name: obs_concept_series

obs_conversion_complete.name: obs_conversion_complete

obs_origin_complete.name: obs_origin_complete
obs_origin_complete.value:
(
      origin_capture_document_id is null and origin_capture_order is null
      and object_sha256 is null and logical_page_index is null and source_bbox is null
      and current_document_id is null and current_page_no is null
    ) or (
      origin_capture_document_id is not null and origin_capture_order >= 1
      and object_sha256 ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$' and logical_page_index >= 1
    )

obs_derived_fields.name: obs_derived_fields
obs_derived_fields.value:
(
      not is_derived
    ) or (
      source = 'derived' and derived_formula is not null and calculation_version is not null
      and derivation_key ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$' and input_observation_ids is not null
      and cardinality(input_observation_ids) > 0 and input_revision_hash ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'
    )

pj_person_scope.name: pj_person_scope
pj_person_scope.value: (subject_type = 'family' and person_id is null) or (subject_type <> 'family' and person_id is not null)

ps_person_scope.name: ps_person_scope
ps_person_scope.value: (subject_type = 'family' and person_id is null) or (subject_type <> 'family' and person_id is not null)
